useful_delta: Recovered the historical Written Mind / Product Memory / Book-first CIP / Canon / Forge model and reconciled it with the current Chat Object architecture. The result is a concrete layered memory lifecycle that keeps FOCUS small, preserves expansive durable cognition with lineage, compacts only gated stable content into Canon, and permits Forge only from a frozen valid Canon/plan. Existing HOT/WARM/COLD context books are identified as reusable retrieval-temperature infrastructure, not as the semantic memory authority itself.

facts.text: The current binding Big Picture explicitly requires Product Memory / Written Mind beyond FOCUS and states the target lineage compact source plane -> expansive Written Mind/Book -> compressed Canon -> executable Forge/context.

FOCUS is already defined as compact current frontier, not transcript summary or full durable memory. The Chat Object is expected to point to Product Memory/Written Mind in addition to FOCUS, design, rules, work and evidence.

The Survival Set requires self-documentation of goals, assumptions, architecture decisions, invariants, failures, owners, delegated work, return consumption and frontier changes; it also requires progressive retrieval rather than loading all history.

A concrete reusable memory precursor already exists at context/books/HOT.json, WARM.json and COLD.json. HOT promotes direct dependencies/active invariants; WARM promotes by task relevance/contradiction; COLD is reopened for explicit historical/rollback need and is never auto-deleted.

Historical Prometeo design recovered through architecture archaeology treated Written Mind/Public Working Memory as large visible durable worker-produced cognition, while compact indexed source input remained separate. The historical sequence was Book/CIP -> valid Book Gate -> dot/Continue -> Forge, with dot meaning continue from the last valid gate rather than Human Accepted.

facts.text: Historical deep-work ingredients repeatedly associated with Book/CIP were broad coverage, model revisions, independent critiques, 4X/challenger passes, Apprentice reconstruction and requirement -> decision -> implementation -> test traceability. Negative knowledge and rejected paths were first-class outputs rather than discarded prose.

facts.text: Current authority laws already separate evidence/candidate/Human Accepted/Current/Served and prohibit newest-wins or worker-self-promotion. The memory plane therefore cannot become product authority merely because an item is remembered or canonical inside a campaign.

layers.role: Raw/reopenable evidence, source cards, files, returns, incidents and external truth with privacy/freshness/authority metadata. It is not loaded wholesale.

Cross-campaign durable semantic memory. Stores structured decisions, rationale, architecture, owner/capability facts, Goldens, Vaccines, incidents, negative knowledge, open hypotheses, test knowledge and reusable crystallized intelligence. Preserve richly; retire/supersede instead of deleting.

Expansive campaign/problem-specific written cognition. It may be large and revisionary. It reduces uncertainty, builds models, carries contradiction/coverage maps and cites Product Memory + evidence. It is not the cross-project memory head and is not itself executable authority.

Compact gated projection of the Book: stable premises, decisions, invariants, negative constraints, unresolved boundaries and exact execution-relevant conclusions, all with backward lineage. Canon is versioned/frozen for a Forge attempt.
Narrow executable compilation from frozen Canon + Active Method + current owner/authority/baseline refs. This is the execution input, not durable memory.

Small operational cache/frontier: current objective, gate, active heads, blockers, workers, exact next action. FOCUS points into the layers above and should be reconstructable from them; no unique durable truth should live only here.

proposal.governing_hierarchy: CONSTITUTION -> ACTIVE_METHOD -> PRODUCT_MEMORY -> PROJECT_NORTH/CAMPAIGN -> BOOK/CIP -> CANON -> FORGE_PLAN -> RUN/EVIDENCE

heads: ACTIVE_METHOD/METHOD_HEAD handled by its own governing layer
proposal.chat_object_behavior: CHAT_OBJECT points to the current heads; FOCUS carries only a compact projection of whichever heads/gates matter to the immediate frontier.
proposal.successor_rule: A fresh successor must resolve heads deterministically before loading deep content, then selectively retrieve only what the active frontier requires.

proposal.rule: Raw private Capture/transcript payload does not get copied into public Product Memory; public memory stores sanitized semantic records and durable refs while private source material stays behind its proper boundary.

lifecycle: OPEN_BOOK from campaign objective + heads + coverage map
CHALLENGE through independent critic / 4X / adversarial passes where warranted
TRACE requirement -> decision -> planned change -> planned test
COMPACT to immutable versioned Canon only after gate PASS
book_gate_required_checks: declared coverage map satisfied or explicit scoped omissions
material claims linked to reopenable evidence
contradictions resolved or explicitly preserved as unresolved
critical source debt is below campaign threshold or explicitly blocking
successor/Apprentice can reconstruct the model and constraints
execution traceability exists for every material requirement
proposal.anti_metric_rule: Word count or chapter count may serve as an anti-premature-closure floor but can never be the Book Gate by itself.

do_not_promote_by_default: discarded alternatives without reusable negative knowledge
large source payloads already reopenable elsewhere
proposal.rule: Compression may reduce text but must not erase causal/provenance links, negative knowledge or known uncertainty. Canon revisions are new immutable versions, not in-place silent rewrites.

proposal.dot_meaning: CONTINUE_FROM_LAST_VALID_GATE. For a Book-first campaign, dot may authorize transition from valid frozen Canon/Book Gate into Forge. It never means Human Accepted, Current, Served, or product Apply.
forge_preconditions: continue/dot gate when the campaign contract requires it
proposal.forge_behavior: Forge mechanically materializes the frozen plan through the normal execution/authority system; it does not improvise new product truth while executing.
proposal.bounded_reopen: If execution evidence invalidates a Canon premise, stop the affected Forge scope, record the invalidation, reopen the minimum Book/CIP slice, issue a new Canon version, re-run the gate, then resume. Do not silently patch the Canon mid-Forge.

proposal.definition: Reusable campaign learning that has survived evidence, challenge, execution feedback and compaction; not raw transcript volume or a large archive.
proposal.promotion_flow: campaign Book/Canon + execution evidence -> steward review -> reusable Product Memory record(s) -> optional Golden/Vaccine/Active Method candidate
examples: cross-campaign decision heuristics with explicit scope
proposal.retirement: Obsolete crystallized records become RETIRED/SUPERSEDED but remain reopenable with lineage.

proposal.rule: Dormant historical material can be correctly preserved/indexed/retrievable without being ACTIVE or EXECUTABLE. This prevents archive existence from silently governing current work.

reuse_and_extend.extension: Keep as retrieval-temperature/context-index layer. Add semantic memory heads/records above it; do not turn temperature tiers into truth/authority states.
Add pointers to PRODUCT_MEMORY_HEAD and current campaign BOOK/CANON/FORGE heads when the parent integrates this design.
Compile selective Book/Canon/Product Memory slices into role/run Working Sets instead of loading full Written Mind.

do_not_build: automatic Canon promotion from worker completion
public copies of private raw transcripts/Capture payloads

evidence.summary: Recovered R29/R31/R38/R70/R77/R78/R94-era design themes: DAY_WORK/no premature closure, challenger/braided revisions, 4X/adaptive depth, compact indexed source plane, public Written Mind/one-worker, and host/Airlock authority. Raw conversation text was not copied into this public return.

conflicts.text: Potential terminology collision: existing context/books HOT/WARM/COLD are called books, while historical Written Book/CIP is a much larger campaign synthesis artifact. Recommendation: preserve existing filenames for compatibility but reserve semantic term Written Book/CIP for campaign cognition; label HOT/WARM/COLD as context-temperature books/indices.

Product Memory can easily become a duplicate authority plane. Candidate design explicitly prevents this: memory records carry authority_class and refs, but Current/Human Accepted/Served remain owned elsewhere.

Expansive Written Mind conflicts with prompt/context limits only if treated as giant linear input. Historical R70 and current progressive-context rules resolve this by separating durable storage from hot attention and compiling selective Working Sets.

unresolved: Parent/steward should reconcile this return with WI-BIG-01 Active Method and WI-BIG-03 Context Foundry returns before selecting final schemas, because memory authority and retrieval/compiler boundaries overlap conceptually.

Exact physical storage backend/path for Product Memory records should be chosen during implementation design after privacy/query/update requirements are reconciled; this scout intentionally does not force JSONL vs database vs object-store prematurely.
Exact Book Gate thresholds are campaign/profile-dependent; the invariant is evidence/coverage/reconstruction/traceability gating, not one universal word-count threshold.

Whether dot/Continue is always required before Forge or only for campaign profiles that explicitly install that human continuation gate should be reconciled with the Campaign Controller job; dot must never imply product acceptance either way.
